entries.heading: JAPN 135A. Professional Skills in Japanese (4)
entries.name: Professional Skills in Japanese
entries.description: Develops spoken and written Japanese for professional settings, comparing organizational and business cultures.
notes: Language-section placement policy: prior Japanese preparation is evaluated using a placement test and oral interview. Students who have lived in Japan or speak Japanese at home must take the placement exam before the fall quarter. This applies to language enrollment, not every Japanese Studies seminar.
Pool label: Japanese for Professional Purposes. Current Professional Skills label preserves the actual professional-language communication subject.

category_review.rationale: The actual description teaches language communication and cultural/business practices, rather than accounting or management implementation.

Neither inspected source explicitly establishes a correction or code equivalence. Preserve both represented identities; no description, prerequisite or credit transfer.
notes: The actual SOCI102 source teaches social-network data collection, analysis and visualization and requires SOCI60 or CSS2 and upper-division standing. This positive related observation does not establish the older pool code identity.
